caseNameFull: Mahan, Secretary of Board of Elections v. Howell City of Virginia Beach v. Howell and Thornton v. Prichard

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. E. D. Va. Probable jurisdiction noted. Cases consolidated and a total of two hours allotted for oral argument. Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these cases. Reported below: 330 F. Supp. 1138.
